method.approach: Chapter-level sim mapping (hand-curated from every C11 sim's teaching text and challenge questions read individually, cross-checked against the game registry, SIM_NODE_MAP.json, agentSims.json and each chapter's node definitions), then per-node diagnostic coverage scoring of each node's 6 diagnostics (q+a+misconception) against the full text of the mapped sim component(s) in frontend/components/simulations/{c6_12,c6_12_new,three}/.
method.heuristic: A diagnostic counts covered when 0.65 * (IDF-weighted share of its question-stem terms present in the sim source text) + 0.35 * (share of its answer terms) >= 0.40. Both the diagnostic and the sim text are stemmed with the same light stemmer and matched by equality or shared prefix, plus a curated synonym table (e.g. gravitation->'kepler/satellite', respiration->'glycolysis/krebs'). IDF is computed over class-11 chapter documents so common academic vocabulary cannot fake coverage. GOLD = all diagnostics covered; PARTIAL = at least two diagnostics covered; MISSING = no mapped sim or fewer than two diagnostics covered. Lexical heuristic - conservative on metaphorical sims; 15 boundary cases were hand-verified (see spot_checks).
limitations: Lexical term-presence scoring, not interaction testing: a sim may exercise a skill without naming it, or name it without a scored interaction.

Sims scoped to topics absent from the node index (organic chemistry, ocean/atmosphere world geography, Java CS, modern-Indian history, electives) deliver nothing to the current node graph and are reported as unmapped sims.
English (Hornbill/Snapshots/Woven Words) and Hindi (Aroh/Vitan) have no sims at all; their 975 nodes are structurally MISSING.
Answer-key defect scan is structural (index range, duplicate options, numeric key type, % of arithmetic); it does not re-derive every computed answer.

spot_checks.description: 15 verdicts across different subjects hand-verified against the actual sim interactions (stratified sample; fixed list recorded in the audit script).

checks.subject: phy
checks.note: Overcall: Gravitation/Kepler/Satellite sims exercise law-of-gravitation computations (G, universal gravitation, orbital velocity, inverse-square) but the vector-form (D2) and three-mass equilateral-superposition (D4) diagnostics are not systematically exercised - no superposition/equilateral content in any of the 4 mapped sims.

checks.subject: math
checks.note: Overcall: the sets sims exercise cardinality, empty-set vs {0}, power-set and one-to-one mappings, but the equal-sets-vs-equivalent-sets distinction (D1-D4 hinge on the words 'equal'/'equivalent') is never named; coverage rides on generic set vocabulary.

checks.subject: acc
checks.note: BRS deeply exercised by both sims: amended-cash-book method, unpresented cheques, bank charges, overdraft starts, dual-extract reconciliation.

checks.subject: chem
checks.note: Kossel-Lewis sim covers lattice enthalpy (x13 mentions), MgO comparisons (x5), ionisation energy and electron-gain vocabulary the diagnostics test.

checks.subject: bio
checks.note: Cell-wall sim covers wall layers/plasmodesmata/pectinase-cellulase reasoning; algal-vs-angiosperm composition and the open design task are genuinely uncovered.

checks.subject: cs
checks.note: ISC exam-rehearsal sim genuinely exercises Boolean algebra: truth tables, half-adder, universal gates (NAND x15 / NOR x16), distribution law.

checks.subject: cs
checks.note: StringSlicingSim is all slice notation/negative indices; the diagnostics test type(), escape sequences, immutability TypeError and IndexError - none appear in the sim.

checks.subject: hist
checks.note: WritingCityLife sim is a thin urbanism explainer (scribe x6, no Tigris/Euphrates/cuneiform/ecological-zones content) versus geography-of-Mesopotamia diagnostics.

checks.subject: geo
checks.note: Undercall: hazards sim carries hazard x34 / disaster x17 / cyclone x6 / earthquake x5 / vulnerability x5 - it genuinely exercises the hazard-vs-disaster definition (D1, covered) and the cyclone-vulnerability data comparison (D3 scored 0.36, just under threshold).

checks.subject: ps
checks.note: Mapping corrected during hand verification: the LegalStudies orders/decrees sim is CPC civil procedure (Munsif courts, written statements) - Article 50, judge tenure and judicial independence never appear. ps ch15 is now unmapped, so the node is structurally MISSING.

checks.subject: eng_h
checks.note: No English sims exist at all for class 11 (Hornbill/Snapshots/Woven Words unserved).

checks.subject: hs
checks.note: Intro-streams sim covers the WHO definition (D1) and wellness-dimensions content (health x21, mental x17); only the case-application task is uncovered.

checks.subject: psy
checks.note: Psych-statistics sim unexpectedly carries Gestalt (x18)/illusion (x16)/attention (x9) content - covers sensation-vs-perception and top-down perception; threshold computations uncovered.

checks.subject: stat
checks.note: Karl-Pearson sim exercises correlation-vs-causation with a verbatim ice-cream/sunburn spurious-correlation challenge and the r-domain rules.

checks.subject: bs
checks.note: Overcall: the Ebanking sim teaches RTGS/NEFT/credit-card mechanics and the Qcommerce sim teaches dark-store operations; neither exercises the NCERT e-business benefits/limitations framework (low personal touch, digital divide, people resistance) the diagnostics test.
